requests_per_user_query.typical_slow_typing: 1 per debounced pause (≥300ms) after min length; aborted requests do not update UI
requests_per_user_query.on_search_commit: +1 GET /products when keyword URL param updates (separate from suggest popup path)

duplicate_requests.same_query_retype: Cache hit avoids redundant UI loading state; inflight dedup prevents parallel identical fetches
duplicate_requests.canary_validation_runs: Shadow canary doubles backend work internally when SEARCH_CANARY=1 — not enabled in production .env
duplicate_requests.observed_canary_log_duplicates: Validation script logged each fixture twice (pairs in canary-metrics jsonl) — not production user traffic

cancelled_requests.mechanism: AbortController.abort() on new keystroke before debounce fires next fetch
cancelled_requests.client_behavior: Aborted fetch returns null; no setState
cancelled_requests.server_behavior: Backend may still complete aborted request (no request cancellation on server)

ignored_late_responses.scenario: User types 'đè' → request A; continues to 'đèn hậu' → abort A, request B; A response ignored if it somehow completed without abort

json_receive_to_render.bottleneck: Backend TTFB dominates; JSON parse + React commit is not user-visible delay source

payload_size_correlation.observation: Slowest queries return largest JSON (đèn hậu Kia 101KB); download adds ~15ms after TTFB on audit network
